cohort: The participants included 347 children with autism spectrum disorder, 117 children with other developmental delays, and 2226 age, sex, and ethnicity-matched controls.
finding: Cesarean section is significantly associated with an increased risk of autism spectrum disorder but not other developmental delays, with this risk specifically elevated when general anesthesia is used during the cesarean section.
mod_finding: Only cesarean sections performed with general anesthesia elevated the risk of autism spectrum disorder, with no significant difference between indicated and non-indicated surgeries.
